summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals, including the addition of primary key constraints and enhancements to the REST Catalog specification for file-level access delegation. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about collation support and the management of existing statistics files.
highlights: Integration updates with Spark and removal of Spark 3.4 support
Proposal for standardized PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE constraints
Discussion on file-level access delegation in the REST Catalog Spec
Implementation of collation support for flexible string comparisons
